sources.authority: Final published article, Equations 1-6, Tables 1-2; official supplemental workbook
sources.reported_error_meaning: Last-digit errors in separate columns, as printed; confidence not specified. XLSX number formats are required: P5=121.30 with Q5=(8) means 0.08 A3, not 0.8 A3.
sources.calibration: KBr B2 Dewaele (2012), MgO Kono (2010), or pyrite-SiO2 Kuwayama (2011) for the ten highest-pressure 300 K rows; paired marker volumes retained.
sources.source_equation: BM3 300 K plus integrated-Gruneisen MGD; n=4 atoms per Fe3C formula, Z=4, theta0 fixed to 314 K, gamma=gamma0*(V/V0)^q, theta=theta0*exp((gamma0-gamma)/q).
source_qualifications: Workbook contains a 2600 K row although the main text says 2450 K maximum. Keep it; no source exclusion documented.
Figure 3 caption reverses dotted/dashed temperature naming relative to its legend. The visible 300 K density is higher than 5000 K at each P.
The KBr and MgO fits are pressure-scale variants of the same observations, not independent experiments. No automatic pressure conversion is authorized.
Standalone source models are staged outside the catalog; high-pressure magnetic-state/structure integration and exact fit workflow remain open.

snapshot_note: Source qualifications retain the 25 October recovery snapshot; current catalog integration and conditional parity are documented in the two Takahashi EOS records and docs/literature-reproductions/takahashi-2019-parity.md.
